answer: A farm running 194 keys hence pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. Because the anchor stake is held until the atlas settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the fable audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 17% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
